name: Dreadmaul Rock
summary: Firegut ogres make their home among the caves and earthen mounds of Dreadmaul Rock in the Burning Steppes.

sections.title: Stronghold of the Firegut
sections.body:
Above the scorched plains of the Burning Steppes, Firegut ogres hold the crags and caves of Dreadmaul Rock. The massive stone formation is cut through by a labyrinthine cave system. Though its name suggests a possible tie to the Dreadmaul ogres of the Blasted Lands, the Firegut clan controls the rock.

They use its high paths, crags, and interior earthen mounds as a defended camp. From there, they dominate the surrounding wasteland and menace anyone crossing the northern slopes toward Blackrock Spire.

aliases: what ogres are at dreadmaul rock
faq.answer: The Firegut ogres use Dreadmaul Rock as their central base. They inhabit its outer cliff paths and the complex cave system within the rock.

faq.q: Why is it named Dreadmaul Rock if Firegut ogres live here?
faq.answer: The Firegut clan controls the peak, though the name suggests the rock may once have belonged to the Dreadmaul ogre clan, which has a large presence south in the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: What is the layout of the rock like?
faq.answer: Steep ramps wind up the crag beside an intricate cave network within, filled with ogre mounds and dwellings.
Dreadmaul Rock rises in the Burning Steppes, north of the path toward the Redridge Mountains and east of Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: For Alliance forces guarding the border passes from Redridge, the aggressive ogres of Dreadmaul Rock are a constant, brutal hazard just across the northern ridge.
Horde travelers crossing the Steppes toward Blackrock Mountain must tread carefully around Dreadmaul Rock and avoid angering the territorial Firegut clan.
